kultivator.technique.zidian_whip.desc: A purple lightning whip lashes the locked foe and leaps to 1→4 more (reach 10→24, each leap weaker): 1.2× power and a 1.5 s stun; the first lash pulls the target 4 blocks.
kultivator.technique.zidian_whip.source: Source: Mo Dao Zu Shi · 紫电 Zidian, Yu Ziyuan's ring that becomes a purple-lightning whip, inherited by Jiang Cheng
kultivator.technique.zidian_whip.lore: The ring on your finger hisses; one flick, and purple lightning answers.
kultivator.technique.lightning_flash_ste: Three Thousand Lightning Movement: Lightning Flash
2 charges (4 s each): flash 8→16 blocks; foes on the path take 0.8× power and a 0.5 s stun. From Deity Transformation the afterimage left behind bursts (radius 3, 1× power).
Source: Battle Through the Heavens ch. 394/509 · the Di-class agility technique Three Thousand Lightning Movement, 1st stage "Lightning Flash"
Your step makes no sound; all that remains is a scorched smell and a violet afterimage.
kultivator.technique.lightning_mark_armo: For 30 s: techniques +15% damage and Speed I. Melee hits arc chain lightning to 1→4 foes (0.5× power); melee attackers are shocked for 0.4× power. From Deity Transformation lightning wings grow (slow falling).
Source: Martial God Asura ch. 1210/1667/3254 · Chu Feng's Lightning Mark, Lightning Armor and Lightning Wings
Lightning is no longer something you call; it wears you.
kultivator.technique.three_thunder_style: Three stages, recast within 4 s: (1) dash 6 blocks, 1.2× power on the path; (2) an 8→14-block cone, 1.5× power + 1 s stun; (3) a thunderclap at the aim (radius 4→8), 2.5× power and a launch. Qi 25/30/45.
Source: Martial God Asura ch. 5 · Three Thunder Styles of the Azure Dragon School's founder: "fast as lightning, strong as thunder"
The first style closes in, the second pins, the third ends it.
kultivator.technique.five_thunder_method: Strike the 令 token up to four times (6 s window): (1) wind pushes (radius 6→12); (2) clouds blind for 3 s; (3) thunder, 5→12 bolts (radius 12→20), 1.5× power + 1 s stun; (4) rain soaks foes for 15 s and puts out your fire. Particles only; the weather never changes.

Source: Journey to the West ch. 45 · the Tiger Strength Immortal strikes his token once for wind, twice for clouds, three times for thunder and lightning, four times for rain; Lord Deng calls it a true 五雷法
One token, four knocks, and the sky keeps to the order.
kultivator.technique.lightning_emperor_a: A hand of lightning points from the sky: a piercing 40→64-block beam, 3× power, marking foes (+30% Lightning damage for 10 s). From Immortal Ascension each foe hit calls 5 small bolts (1× power).
Source: Perfect World ch. 1405 · Lightning Emperor Precious Technique (the finger image and the split are game design)
The emperor need not raise a hand; pointing is enough.
kultivator.technique.golden_light_format: A ring of mirrors at the aim (radius 10→18, 8 s, 7→21 emitters): every second golden light strikes up to 8→16 foes inside, 0.9× power (undead ×1.5) and 2 s of blindness.
Source: Investiture of the Gods ch. 44/46 · 金光陣 of Jin Guang Shengmu: 21 poles with mirrors; thunder shakes them and golden light fires
Whoever looks into those mirrors sees light, and then nothing at all.
kultivator.technique.extinction_thunderc: A purple thundercloud covers the aim (radius 16→32, 10 s): 40 bolts, each 1.5× power + 0.5 s stun; at the end every foe beneath takes 4× power.
Source: Against the Gods · 紫云功 Purple Cloud Art, 8th realm 寂灭雷云 Extinction Thundercloud
That cloud brings no rain. It brings an ending.
kultivator.technique.divine_sword_imperi: Charge 1.5 s (cast again = release early): sky lightning falls into your sword and fires 32→64 blocks, 5× power (×0.7 without a sword in hand); from its end lightning chains to 6 foes, 2× power.
Source: Jade Dynasty (Zhu Xian) · 神剑御雷真诀 Divine Sword Imperial Thunder Art, the Qingyun Sect's signature spell
Raise your sword to the sky, and the sky answers through the blade.
kultivator.technique.lei_zhenzi_wings.de: A 20 s form: wind-thunder wings give real flight (3 qi/s), the golden staff gives +50% attack and +2 reach; melee hits burst with lightning (radius 3, 1.5× power). Cast again: dive 16 blocks, 2× power along the path.
kultivator.technique.lei_zhenzi_wings.so: Source: Investiture of the Gods ch. 21 · Lei Zhenzi eats two red apricots, grows wings marked "wind" and "thunder", and receives a golden staff from Yunzhongzi
kultivator.technique.lei_zhenzi_wings.lo: Two apricots, two wings, and the sky is no longer a limit.
kultivator.technique.lei_zhenzi_wings.pl: Only a player can grow Lei Zhenzi's wings.
kultivator.technique.lei_zhenzi_wings.bu: Another flight art is already carrying you.
kultivator.technique.lei_zhenzi_wings.un: The wings cannot fly here right now.
kultivator.technique.lei_zhenzi_wings.no: Out of qi: Lei Zhenzi's wings fade.
kultivator.technique.tribulation_thunder: Charge 2 s: a 60-block thunder sword falls from the sky and sweeps along the aim (48→64 blocks), 6× power, +1% per tribulation strike you ever survived (up to +100%); 5 lightning pillars strike foes near the aim, 2× power.
Source: Against the Gods · 天劫雷剑 Heavenly Tribulation Thunder Sword, part of Yun Che's Heavenly Dao Divine Power (天道神力)
Every strike that once nearly killed you is now your blade.
kultivator.technique.thunderbolt_ancestr: A domain that follows you (radius 24→32, 15 s): every 0.5 s a random foe is struck (1.5× power), every 3 s a lightning burst (radius 12, 2× power); Lightning cooldowns recover twice as fast.
Source: Martial Universe ch. 969/982/1033 · Thunderbolt Ancestral Symbol, one of the eight Ancestral Symbols (the sun image is visual flavour only)
The violet orb above your head is never still, and never misses.
kultivator.technique.tribulation_thunder: A vast array at the aim (radius 24→32, 10 s): nine tribulation strikes hit up to 32 foes, each 2× power + 8% of max health (bosses 3%); the 9th strike is doubled. Qi 55% (min 700).
Source: Against the Gods · 天劫雷帝阵 Heavenly Tribulation Thunder Emperor Array, part of the Heavenly Dao Divine Power (the strikes as a share of max health are game design)
You once endured the heavens' tribulation. Now you are the one who sends it.
kultivator.technique.nine_heavens_thunde: A 20 s form (×1.5 when there is room) with 12 thunder deities in the clouds (attacking every 0.5 s, range 24→40, 2× power); every 4 s a radius-40 burst, 4× power + 2 s stun; at the end up to 64 foes within 40 take 8× power. Qi 75%.
Source: Investiture of the Gods ch. 99 · Wen Zhong is invested as 九天應元雷聲普化天尊, leading the 24 deities of the Thunder Department
The third eye opens, and twenty-four thunder deities await your word.
